name: Repeated MBTI type code ENFP
description: Fires on the four-letter Myers-Briggs type label ENFP, especially when chanted or repeated, plus ENTP and second-person 'you're'.

name: ENTJ Myers-Briggs type mentions
description: Activates on the MBTI type code ENTJ (and ESFP), often in profanity-laced exclamations about the type, e.g. 'Where the FUCK is ENTJ'.

name: Negating un- prefix and unfalsifiable claims
description: Fires on words with the negating 'un-' prefix such as unfalsifiable, uncivilized, uncivil, often in statements that a claim or hypothesis cannot be tested.

name: Chanted MBTI codes ENFP and ENTP
description: Activates on long repeated strings of the Myers-Briggs type abbreviations ENFP and ENTP, plus hedging words like maybe and sounds.

name: Cricket and rugby player commentary
description: Fires on sports talk about cricket bowlers and rugby league players, e.g. Origin players, pace bowlers, Pro Bowler, with names like Pearce and Starc.

name: Staring and stares to death
description: Activates on the verb stare and its inflections (staring, stared), often in hyperbolic phrasing about staring at walls, across rooms, or staring to death.

name: Enumerated a) b) option lists
description: Fires on inline enumerations marked with parenthesized letters 'a)' and 'b)' laying out two or more listed options or reasons.

name: Independent and independently
description: Activates on the word independent and related forms (independently, financially independent), as in independent city or independent endeavor.

name: Crude filling and bodily-fluid slang
description: Fires on coarse sexual or scatological slang about filling, with tokens like fill, filled, cum, and shit; pattern is vulgar wordplay.

name: Praise for MS Paint artwork
description: Activates on casual approval phrasing such as 'pretty good for MS paint', referencing the MS Paint program and image edits.
